description: Append one action to your notary log: send the SHA-256 (hex) of the action you computed locally (never the content). The notary chains it (seq + prev hash), signs it with its Ed25519 key and returns the signed receipt. Log heads are anchored to Bitcoin hourly.

entry_sha256.description: sha256 hex of the action (e.g. of its JSON)

kind.description: optional label, e.g. tool_call, decision, output (a-z0-9_.:-, max 32)

note.description: optional public plain-text note (no links, no secrets)

name: notary_append
